audit_scope: Distributed Failure, Compound-Fault & Recovery Correctness Verification

environment_limitations.description: Production Redis cluster / standalone server is not running on the local host. Concurrency and idempotency coordination were exercised using MULTI_PROCESS_EMULATION and RedisStore fallback store.
environment_limitations.impact: Algorithm and CAS contracts verified, but physical Redis network failover/clustering is not certified in this environment.

environment_limitations.description: Production PostgreSQL service is not active on the host. Database persistence was exercised against SQLite with synchronous file operations.
environment_limitations.impact: Application CAS contracts verified, but multi-node PostgreSQL row-level locks (SELECT FOR UPDATE) were not exercised against physical PG server.
